chosen_titles.rationale: Title 24 - LEGISLATURE AND LOBBYING explicitly names lobbying; AK codifies its lobbyist registration and disclosure regime under AS 24.45 (Regulation of Lobbying) within this title.

notes: Single-regime state. AK 2015 index lists 46 titles; only Title 24 carries lobbying-disclosure content (AS 24.45). Title 39 (Public Officers and Employees) houses general ethics rules but not the lobbying-disclosure statute itself.
